outcome: Prevalence of levator ani muscle (LAM) injuries
cohort: Women with a history of one Caesarean section
finding: Women who underwent VBAC had a statistically significant higher risk of LAM avulsion and a higher occurrence of overdistended hiatal area compared to women who underwent ERCS.
mod_finding: VBAC was associated with a statistically significant higher risk of LAM avulsion.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight of 4,000 g or higher was a risk factor for LAM injury in the VBAC group.
